description: Manually clear the incremental import cache at ~/.apple-health-mcp/incremental-cache.json. The cache tracks the latest parsed timestamp per HealthKit category so subsequent `apple_health_list_records` calls (with `incremental_cache: true`) skip already-seen records. Use this when you want to force a full re-parse without changing the export file. The cache also auto-invalidates when the export file mtime changes. Gated by explicit_user_intent: true (requires explicit user intent to wipe local cache).
name: apple_health_clear_incremental_cache
title: Clear Apple Health Incremental Import Cache
